subject: Milestone-linked pricing proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma@luminex.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Milestone-linked pricing proposal and next steps

Hi Emma — great to meet today, and thanks for walking us through Luminex's product milestones. Quick recap and a concrete proposal so we have clear next steps: 

Key signals from the call:
- You expect peak inference during batch indexing runs: ~120M tokens/month for the first 6 months, then stepping to ~400M/month after product launch (month 9).
- Initial budget window for POC: $12k–18k/month; post-launch budget expansion contingent on Series A close in Q1.
- Security: SOC2 in progress; billing needs to sit with Luminex US entity.

What we propose (attached: Luminex_PRICING_DRAFT.xlsx):
1) Startup program bridge: 20% startup credit for months 1–6 (applied to hosted usage).
2) Milestone-linked committed band: a 6-month committed-use agreement that ramps by milestone with blended unit economics: 
   - Band A (0–150M tokens/mo): $1,100 per 1M tokens (first 3 months)
   - Band B (151–400M tokens/mo): $850 per 1M tokens after launch milestone (months 4–6)
3) Multi-year sweetener: if you sign a 24-month term at minimum monthly commit forecast of 250M tokens, we can add a 10% rebate on year-two spend (subject to forecast carveouts).

Example math (goal: target $/1M tokens):
- Initial POC: 120M tokens * $1,100/1M = ~$132,000/month gross; with 20% credit effective spend $105,600/month.
- Post-launch ramp: 400M tokens * $850/1M = $340,000/month gross; with rebate mechanics reduces effective rate.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm whether the milestone triggers (indexing complete, public launch) and expected month numbers.
- Share cap table or funding timeline (we only need high level to qualify for startup bracket).
- If you like the structure, Marissa will prepare a short commercial term sheet and we’ll loop legal for a simple committed-use addendum.

Attachments: Luminex_PRICING_DRAFT.xlsx (pricing bands + example invoice), proposal template.

If this looks directionally right I can lock the numbers for internal approval today and get a draft over by Monday.

Thanks — talk soon,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0182

From: Emma Zhou <emma@luminex.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Milestone-linked pricing proposal and next steps

Marcus—thanks for the clear recap and the draft. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Milestones:
   - Indexing complete = end of internal beta (targeting mid-November).
   - Public launch = our planned GA (targeting late Jan).
2) Volumes: your numbers match internal forecasts. Expect lower token churn during beta (40–120M/mo), moving to 350–450M/mo after GA depending on retention.
3) Budget: current runway allows us to commit up to ~$150k/month for 3–4 months post-beta; beyond that we’ll need to bring in Series A to expand.
4) Startup eligibility: we qualify (pre-Series A, <$5M ARR). I’m attaching a cap table snapshot for your PSR.

On discounts: the proposed two-band ramp looks reasonable, but we’re most sensitive to the $/1M tokens in the immediate post-launch window. Can Redwood provide a target effective $/1M after startup credit that stays below $900/1M at scale? Also curious if there’s flexibility on the startup credit timing — e.g., apply credits to overage only vs. gross spend.

I’ve cc'd our billing alias (billing@luminex.ai) for any procurement/PO questions. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week to finalize the milestone definitions.

Thanks,
Emma Zhou
CEO, Luminex AI
Attachments: Luminex_cap_table.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma@luminex.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Milestone-linked pricing proposal and next steps

Emma — really helpful, and congrats on the progress. Quick responses and an updated, binding-ish path so procurement has something concrete: 

- Target effective rate: yes, we can structure the first 12 months so your effective $/1M (after startup credit and expected rebates) is under $900/1M at the 350–450M/month scale. I’ll preserve the pricing bands in the attachment but show the blended effective numbers in the proposal_20270903.pdf attached.

- Credit application: we can scope the 20% startup credit to apply to gross hosted usage for the first 6 months, or alternatively restrict it to overage beyond a small baseline; I’ve tabled both options in the proposal so you can pick the one that helps runway best.

- Procurement notes: for PO/billing we’ll (i) provide a commercial sheet, (ii) accept PO to Redwood US entity, and (iii) work with your billing team to align invoice cadence.

Next steps (owners):
- Emma: confirm preferred credit application and which milestone you want to use as the launch trigger (internal beta vs. public GA).
- Luminex billing: share PO requirements and required legal billing entity.
- Marissa (pricing): will finalize the commercial term sheet and lock the effective $/1M bands for internal approval.
- Aisha (rev ops): will prepare contract checklist and propose payment terms.

I’ll schedule a 30-minute sync for Wed 09/08 at 10am PT unless I hear otherwise. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the finalized proposal.

Thanks again — I’ll push the draft through today.

Best,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposal_20270903.pdf
